purposes.title: Emphasizing a Target
purposes.description: Highlight a selected geospatial target by directing attention to it.

purposes.title: Overviewing Multiple Targets
purposes.description: Show several targets or the surrounding spatial context as a whole.

purposes.title: Making a Comparison
purposes.description: Move between or frame multiple targets to support contrast or analogy.

purposes.title: Supplementing Information
purposes.description: Reserve visual space or alter the view to add contextual information.

purposes.title: Increasing Dynamics
purposes.description: Animate the current view without a selected target to add continuity and energy.

cameras.title: Static shot
cameras.description: Hold the selected target in frame for emphasis.

cameras.title: Push in shot
cameras.description: Move closer to a location or region to draw attention to details.

cameras.title: Pull out shot
cameras.description: Start from the target and reveal its nearby context.

cameras.title: Pan shot
cameras.description: Move from the current view to a selected target.

cameras.title: Camera roll
cameras.description: Rotate around the selected target to show it from a different orientation.

cameras.title: Arc shot
cameras.description: Orbit around a selected target for a stronger emphasis effect.

cameras.title: Tilt shot
cameras.description: Tilt the camera to reveal height or visual salience.

cameras.title: Tracking shot
cameras.description: Follow a selected path to emphasize its shape and progression.

cameras.title: Push in & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Move closer while tilting to emphasize a central object.

cameras.title: Arc & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Orbit and tilt around a selected target for a cinematic emphasis.

cameras.title: Pan & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Pan to a target while changing pitch for emphasis.

cameras.title: Static shot
cameras.description: Hold an overview frame to show the selected spatial context.

cameras.title: Push in shot
cameras.description: Move from context toward a group or region.

cameras.title: Pull out shot
cameras.description: Reveal the surrounding context of a target or region.

cameras.title: Pan shot
cameras.description: Move across selected targets to build an overview.

cameras.title: Camera roll
cameras.description: Rotate the view to add perspective while preserving overview context.

cameras.title: Arc shot
cameras.description: Orbit around the selected context to make an overview more dynamic.

cameras.title: Tilt shot
cameras.description: Tilt the view to show spatial distribution or height in context.

cameras.title: Trucking shot
cameras.description: Move laterally across targets for a broad contextual scan.

cameras.title: Tracking shot
cameras.description: Follow a path to show its full spatial course.

cameras.title: Push in & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Move into an overview while tilting to reveal height or context.

cameras.title: Arc & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Orbit and tilt around the selected context.

cameras.title: Pan & Tilt shot
cameras.description: Pan through a selected context while changing pitch.

cameras.title: Pull out shot
cameras.description: Pull out from one target to frame the compared targets together.

cameras.title: Push in shot
cameras.description: Move into a compared target after framing the comparison context.

cameras.title: Pan shot
cameras.description: Pan between two compared targets.

cameras.title: Static shot
cameras.description: Hold a shared comparison frame.

cameras.title: Side-by-side split
cameras.description: Show the two most recent selections in a temporary split screen at equal zoom.

cameras.title: Pan & Push in shot
cameras.description: Pan between targets and end by pushing into the comparison target.

cameras.title: Pull out shot
cameras.description: Pull out from a target to provide room for supplemental context.

cameras.title: Push in shot

cameras.title: Pan shot

cameras.title: Tilt shot

cameras.title: Camera roll shot

cameras.title: Pull out & Camera roll shot

cameras.title: Pan & Tilt shot

cameras.title: Arc & Pull out shot
